title: Industrial Corridors
definition: An Industrial Corridor is a packaged cluster of world-class infrastructure—comprising high-speed rail/freight corridors, ports, airports, power grids, and specialized manufacturing nodes—designed to stimulate rapid economic growth and manufacturing competitiveness along a specific geographical axis.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for GS Paper III (Indian Economy, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, and Regional Development) and Prelims (mapping of corridors, PM GatiShakti, NICDC, and special economic zones).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Industrial Corridors.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of infrastructure financing, logistics, and manufacturing policy.
